items.hook_text: If your shoulders live up by your ears, your nervous system is stuck in defense.
items.somatic_practice: Jaw unhinge + bilateral shoulder drop + slow 6s audible sigh
items.visual_aesthetic: Slow water ripples on dark stone, 60fps macro nature, high-contrast white text
items.retention_mechanic: Viewer immediately checks their shoulders upon hearing the hook (physical mirror effect); 3-second silence forces viewer to perform the breath with the creator.
items.bridge: Transition from bodily tension into unconditional witnessing stillness.

items.hook_text: Stop trying to calm your mind with your mind. Do this with your eyes right now.
items.somatic_practice: Stanley Rosenberg Oculomotor Reset (Lateral gaze hold behind head)
items.audio_pairing: 396Hz low grounding frequency + warm brown noise
items.visual_aesthetic: Forest canopy looking upward through sunlight, slow rotation optic flow
items.retention_mechanic: Viewer holds their eyes sideways while watching screen, preventing swipe-away until the involuntary sigh occurs at second 28.
items.bridge: The eyes soften; presence replaces surveillance.

items.hook_text: Kya aapka dimaag har waqt kisi anjaane khatre ke intezaar mein rehta hai?
items.somatic_practice: Hand on chest & belly + extended exhalation + Sakshi Bhaav bridge
items.audio_pairing: 528Hz pure frequency + subtle tanpura drone in C#
items.visual_aesthetic: Slow-motion banyan leaves swaying in wind, warm natural light, Devanagari stacked subtitles
items.retention_mechanic: Names nighttime generalized anxiety; grounds into visceral chest touch; viewer saves reel to re-listen during bedtime racing thoughts.
items.bridge: Sakshi Bhaav: The body is anxious, but the watcher of the body is free.

items.hook_text: Jeebh ko taalu se alag karke dekho. Dekho kitna tanaav ek pal mein chhoot jata hai.
items.somatic_practice: Tongue drop from roof of mouth + jaw release + Shiva-Shakti stillness
items.visual_aesthetic: Flowing mountain stream over smooth pebbles, deep green biophilic tone
items.retention_mechanic: Immediate physical test: 95% of viewers realize their tongue was clenched against palate. High immediate gratification.
items.bridge: Shiva holds the stillness; Shakti relaxes the physical body.

items.hook_text: Je tussi har vele andar ik be-chaini mehsus karde ho, ik mint layi saare bojh hethan rakh dyo.
items.somatic_practice: Shoulder drop + physiological sigh + Sehaj & Simran grounding
items.visual_aesthetic: Golden wheat field moving gently in morning breeze, Gurmukhi script on top line, English transliteration below
items.retention_mechanic: Visceral mother-tongue comfort; absence of preachiness; deep emotional resonance in diaspora and Punjab.
items.bridge: Sehaj: Stepping out of survival urgency into the eternal Timeless (Akal).

items.hook_text: Hath dil te dhar ke mehsoos karo: saans chal rahi hai, tusi theek ho.
items.somatic_practice: Hand on heart containment + peripheral room orienting + Akal presence
items.visual_aesthetic: Slow sunlight piercing morning mist through trees, warm biophilic grading
items.retention_mechanic: Direct maternal/protective grounding; breaks panic loop; viral sharing to family groups and WhatsApp.
items.bridge: Simran as breath-anchored presence; resting in the creator's order (Hukam).
